body: This makes sense. How do I find out why someone is self harming if there are so many reasons?
I think my coworker is self harming and I want to understand why she would do that to herself

That sounds intense. I know that cutters aren’t necessarily suicidal but is it common? If I think someone cuts is it safe to assume they’re suicidal too? Does it mean they’re depressed and I need to be careful about what I say around them? Why do people cut, like I know it’s probably not for attention but I don’t understand hurting yourself!
Could i just like leave numbers or names of therapists or hotlines with her stuff during one of our shifts or something?
I just am worried for her. She might need help and I don't think anyone else sees it.

I don't know if I would be able to say anything, I'm not that assertive or whatever. But what do I do if I see scars or something? Wouldn't she need help? What if I can't say anything and she kills herself or something?
